notes.title: Sudden Strike 5 | FAQ
notes.content:
[h1][u]Sudden Strike 5 | FAQ[/u][/h1][p][/p][p][img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/5a0a1f_14a1778d8ec14fe4bffe549b3e8bf11d~mv2.jpg/v1/fill/w_454,h_341,al_c,q_80,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_avif,quality_auto/5a0a1f_14a1778d8ec14fe4bffe549b3e8bf11d~mv2.jpg"][/img][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=","][tr][td][p align="initial"][b]Genre[/b][/p][/td][td][p align="initial"]Real-Time-Strategy[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p align="initial"][b]Release Date[/b][/p][/td][td][p align="initial"]2026[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p align="initial"][b]Age Rating[/b][/p][/td][td][p align="initial"]IARC Rating: ESRB Teen PEGI 16[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p align="initial"][b]Platforms[/b][/p][/td][td][p align="initial"]PC (Steam, Epic Games Store), Xbox on PC, Xbox Series X|S & PlayStation®5[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/5a0a1f_24a2a30aa87a4e6ab7c6e966778667ec~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_577,h_105,al_c,q_85,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_avif,quality_auto/5a0a1f_24a2a30aa87a4e6ab7c6e966778667ec~mv2.png"][/img][/p][h3] [i][b]"Are there different ways to complete a mission in Sudden Strike 5?[/b][/i][/h3][p align="initial"][i]Yes, there are different ways to complete a mission in Sudden Strike 5. Thanks to the sandbox-style of the missions, you can take different routes and apply various tactics to reach your goal. There are also secondary objectives and points of interest – if you reach and capture these, it will give you strategic advantages like air support and supply depots. For example, capturing checkpoints at the edge of the map prevents enemy reinforcements coming from outside the map.[/i][/p][p align="initial"][i]The final objective remains the same but the path to this objective is decided by YOUR actions!"[/i][/p][p][/p][h3]You can find all the details and the complete FAQ on our blog![/h3][p][url="https://www.kalypsomedia.com/post/sudden-strike-5-faq" style="button" buttoncolor="#3676bf"]FAQ - Blog[/url]  [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2808550/Sudden_Strike_5" style="button" buttoncolor="#ce2778"] Steam Store[/url]  [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/2808550/discussions/" style="button" buttoncolor="#862fc1"]Forum[/url] [/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/5a0a1f_40ff44cac6cd4c9d82775bd38514af7a~mv2.gif"][/img][/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: [CLOSED] Sudden Strike 5 Closed Beta Wildcard Competition!
notes.content: [h1]Sudden Strike 5 Closed Beta Wildcard Competition![/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45702302/80683d74d15fdd4527cca83420b6b4d092cef977.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Generals, prepare to advance on a Community Wildcard-Key for the Closed Beta of Sudden Strike 5![/p][p]We're thrilled to see so many requests to participate in the Closed Beta on Steam. The invitation e-mails were sent yesterday and, unfortunately, some couldn’t join the ranks. BUT: We are opening up supply lines to grant you ONE LAST CHANCE to be a part of the development journey of the new Sudden Strike game:[/p][p]We are giving away 2 Steamkeys for the Closed Beta of Sudden Strike 5! Here's what you need to do 👇[/p][p]💬 [b]Tell us YOUR favourite mission from the Sudden Strike series in the comments of this post.[/b][/p][p]Please read the terms and conditions: [/p][p][url="https://www.kalypsomedia.com/community-terms-conditions"]https://www.kalypsomedia.com/community-terms-conditions[/url][/p][p][/p][p][b]This competition is running until July 29[i]th[/i][/b]. [/p][p][/p][p]On July 30[i]th[/i] we'll pick a winner and notify you via DM (and send you our NDA to sign), so make sure to keep an eye on your friendrequests. 😉 Keep in mind that [b]only our Community Managers Freeky ([/b][dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/id/FreekyTobi/"][/dynamiclink]) [b]and Lunareiya ([/b][url="https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561199474890142/"]https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561199474890142/[/url]) [b] will contact you about the Competition![/b][/p][p][/p][p][i]Good luck, Generals![/i] [/p]

notes.title: Sudden Strike 5 Announced for Release in 2026!
notes.content: [h1]Sudden Strike 5 Announced for Release in 2026 – Closed Beta Recruitment Begins Today![/h1][p][/p][p]Publisher Kalypso Media and Developer Kite Games proudly announce Sudden Strike 5, the fifth instalment of the fan-favourite real-time tactics series. Sudden Strike 5 will be released in 2026, delivering authentic, tactical World War II battles to PC (Steam, Epic Games), Xbox PC, Xbox Series X|S, and PlayStation®5 with Closed Beta registration beginning today on Steam. [/p][p]Hopeful recruits can now enlist for the upcoming Closed Beta via the official sign-up page: [url="https://www.kalypsomedia.com/sudden-strike-5"]https://www.kalypsomedia.com/sudden-strike-5[/url].[/p][p][/p][p][b]Sudden Strike 5[/b] returns to the front lines of World War II, where the trenches of war-torn Europe and North Africa immerse both new recruits and hardened soldiers in challenging historical scenarios. With a [b]25-mission campaign, more than 300 playable units, customizable Commanders,[/b] and [b]PvP gameplay,[/b] [b]Sudden Strike 5[/b] raises the stakes higher than ever before to create the most epic large-scale tactical warfare experience in the series to date.[/p][p][/p][p]Become the mastermind behind the battle. Control over [b]300 historical units[/b] with [b]190 vehicles[/b] and[b] 110 infantry units [/b]including famous WWII vehicles from the Western Allies, German, and Soviet troops like the [b]Sherman Tank, Messerschmidt Bf 109,[/b] and the [b]T-34[/b]. Outsmart the enemy at every turn to capture strategic locations and gain access to reinforcements or destroy bridges to cut off enemy movement while managing supplies to turn the tide of battle.[/p][p][/p][p]Customizable Commanders provide an opportunity to develop tactics that fit any playstyle, whether offensive, defensive or a more tactical approach. Each unique skill, when deployed properly, has the potential to alter the course of war. Seize and defend key locations like Field [b]HQs, Supply Depots[/b], and[b] Train Stations[/b] to gain critical advantages while using recon, sabotage, alternative routing, and smart unit combinations to outmanoeuvre your enemies. [/p][p][/p][p][b]Sudden Strike 5 will be released in 2026[/b] on [b]PC (Steam, Epic Games), Xbox PC, Xbox Series X|S, [/b]and [b]PlayStation®5[/b], with [b]Closed Beta[/b] registration beginning today. For those eager to jump into the front lines of the Closed Beta, please visit [url="https://www.kalypsomedia.com/sudden-strike-5"]https://www.kalypsomedia.com/sudden-strike-5[/url] to apply for early testing access.[/p][previewyoutube="8AnOxEF8cco;full"][/previewyoutube][p]To celebrate the announcement, the base game and each individual DLC for [b]Sudden Strike 4[/b] are now only €4 each, until Sunday with the Complete Collection available for €16.[/p][p][/p][h3]Features[/h3][list][*][p][b]Command massive battles: Sudden Strike 5 [/b]delivers a truly immersive strategy experience 25 missions across huge, diverse maps and the highest unit counts ever seen in the series, setting the stage for large-scale tactical warfare. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Deploy a vast arsenal of WW2 units: Command over 300 authentic units – including more than 190 vehicles and 110 infantry units – such as the Sherman tank for the Western Allies, the Messerschmidt Bf 109 for the German troops, and the T-34 for the Soviet troops. [/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Shape your strategy in dynamic mission gameplay: Utilize unprecedented strategic freedom by choosing your own tactics, units, and objectives to complete the mission goals. Seize and defend key locations like Field HQs, Supply Depots, and Train Stations to gain critical advantages, while using recon, sabotage, alternative routing, and smart unit combinations to outmanoeuvre your enemies. [/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Adapt your tactics with customisable commanders: Choose the Commander that best fits your playstyle and tactics – whether offensive, defensive, or more tactical. Each brings unique skills that can turn the tide of battle, such as deploying smoke grenades to provide cover on the battlefield or boosting the accuracy of your artillery.  [/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Take full control of the battlefield: Extended camera options let you zoom out for full strategic oversight or zoom in for a closer look at the frontline action, giving you better control over every aspect of the battlefield. [/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Challenge yourself and others: Test your strategy against real opponents or AI enemies across multiple difficulty levels, offering competitive PvP challenges.  [/b][/p][/*][/list]
